usedFor: Freelancers use Harpoon to track clients and projects, reacting to “New Client” and adding costs with “Create Expense”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Harpoon
bestTemplate.why: A new client usually needs a project next, so it can start “Create Project”.

watchOut: “New Client” in Harpoon is polling, so a short delay after a client appears is normal.
